description:
## Objective

Generate and enforce one complete quality report.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U24`
Covers: `R11`, `R13` through `R22`; `KTD9` through `KTD17`

This task combines contract validation, suite evidence, Covenant coverage, component proof, line coverage, stability findings, and waivers into one pass or fail result.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: `jido-07x.23` for package, component, and suite coverage artifacts.
- Unblocks: `jido-07x.6`, `jido-07x.7`, `jido-07x.8`, and `jido-07x.20` with the objective quality gate.

## Branch and integration rule

- Base: `main` after the completed U23 ticket.
- Combine: Execute directly on `main` per KTD16. Do not create a branch, worktree, or pull request.

## Source inventory

- One quality contract from U21 — validate before execution.
- One component proof register from U22 — require complete ownership and proof.
- One coverage artifact family from U23 — include package, component, and suite results.
- One existing Covenant coverage artifact — require 323 of 323 current obligations until the contract changes.

## API and behavior map

- Property and fuzz report metadata -> combined quality report metadata. Evidence: `test/property/**/support/report.exs`.
- Suite-local pass results -> one contract-owned outcome. Evidence: `mix.exs` focused aliases.
- Covenant and line coverage -> component findings. Evidence: `test/contracts/coverage.json` and U23 artifacts.

## Files

- Read: `test/quality/quality_contract.yml`, `test/quality/component_proof.yml`, `test/quality/coverage_baseline.json`, `test/contracts/coverage.json`
- Change: `mix.exs`, `test/quality/README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`
- Add: `test/quality/report_test.exs`, `test/quality/support/report.exs`
- Do not change: `lib/**`, `../refs/**`, report output paths outside ignored `tmp/quality/`
- Expected shared changes: None

## Instructions

1. Reject an invalid quality contract before suite execution.
2. Collect every required evidence artifact and fail closed when one is missing.
3. Write matching JSON and text reports with revision and runtime metadata.
4. Preserve unresolved stability failures across later successful runs.
5. Add the focused report and full quality aliases to contributor guidance.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Passing evidence produces matching JSON and text pass results.
- [ ] Missing suite, Covenant, proof, or coverage evidence fails and names its owner.
- [ ] A prior unresolved failure remains visible after a later pass.
- [ ] A valid waiver changes only its owned finding and remains visible.
- [ ] `jido-07x.6`, `.7`, `.8`, and `.20` cannot start before this task closes.
- [ ] No file under `lib/**` or `../refs/**` changes.

## Verification

- `mix test test/quality/report_test.exs --seed 0` — exits with status `0`.
- `mix quality.report` — writes `tmp/quality/quality.json` and `tmp/quality/quality.txt` with matching outcomes.
- `mix format --check-formatted` — exits with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, report artifacts, verification results, active waivers, stability findings, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.
title: Generate and enforce the quality report
